First, we write out the inner summation by summing over the index $i:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}ij & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{2}[{\sum }_{i=1}^{3}ij] \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{2}(1j+2j+3j) \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{2}(j+2j+3j) \\  & ={\sum }_{j=1}^{2}6j\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we sum over the index $j:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{j=1}^{2}6j & =6\cdot 1+6\cdot 2 \\  & =6+12 \\  & =18\end{aligned}
$$
